rows: Eulogy
Acknowledgment → specific stories → relational turn → close
One vivid detail; shift from "she" to "you" at the end
Toast (wedding/retirement)
Relationship → one story → connection to occasion → direct address toast
Hold the person's defining quality to the story; no lists of attributes
Award presentation
Award's meaning → criteria → accomplishments → name (held to last)
Don't lead with the name; use the reveal
Award acceptance
Gratitude (specific names) → meaning of the work → forward declaration
Elevate beyond personal thanks
All-Hands address
Acknowledge reality → interpret meaning → specific recognition → direction → values close
Specific stories beat name-lists; acknowledge before pivoting
Commencement
Subvert or execute the convention with full awareness
One strong idea; one memorable line; specific over general
Inaugural
Transition acknowledgment → shared values → situation → principles → peroration
No policy; pure epideictic; the values statement IS the content
